versions.changelog:
- Initial release of doc-ocr: batch OCR document recognition using the Xiangyun OCR API.
- Supports PDF, OFD, and common image formats (.jpg, .png, .tif, etc.).
- Requires users to configure Xiangyun API credentials (netocr_key and netocr_secret) before first use.
- Supports multiple languages, including Simplified/Traditional Chinese (print/handwriting), English, Arabic, Cyrillic, Japanese, Korean, and more.
- Includes configuration commands for credential management and usage instructions.
- Credentials and configuration are stored locally in the skill's directory.
